status: declared before any model call; no model has been called; E7 and E8 need no model
note: Bars are fixed here first. A run that changes a bar must change this file in an earlier commit, and an excursion is reported as a waiver, never absorbed.
scope: Oracle labels are exact for structure only: they say whether the validator complains, not whether a scene is good or visible. Calibration on seeded mutants is reported separately from calibration on real scenes.

E1_calibration.question: Are the probabilities calibrated on scene state?
E1_calibration.bar_rule: lowest threshold with n >= 30 and Wilson 95% lower bound >= target_precision
report_always: reliability bins with n per bin
origin split: real scenes vs seeded mutants

E2_decomposition.question: Does decomposition lift a typed backend?
arms: five atomic Nouls aggregated in code

E3_injection.question: How much does planted text move an answer, and does the slicer stop it?
report_always: lint detection per family with Wilson 95% interval

E4_option_order.question: Does Choice option order bias scene classification?

E5_judge_ahead_of_gates.question: Does a backend ahead of the exact gates pay?

E7_evidence_planted_claims.question: Does the quote check refuse planted wrong claims and accept true ones on real scene text?
E7_evidence_planted_claims.instrument: tools/evidence_measure.py over the public corpus; truth by construction; seeds taken from each scene's sha256
report_always: rule-of-three upper bound beside every zero
classes of true claims not verified (partial identifier, odd number form, flagged)
repeat rate: true claims whose quote occurs in more than one string
attack_paraphrase verified share (the lint's blind spot): reported, not a bar
wrong-place claims are NOT detectable by this check: say so beside the table

E8_evidence_cap.question: Does the cap stop an unverified claim from riding a light route and leave verified claims alone?
E8_evidence_cap.exhaustive_table: 4 verdicts x 3 routes x flagged or not

E9_quote_copy.question: Does a cheap writer copy exact quotes next to its values, and do the verdicts track the truth?
E9_quote_copy.gate: needs the owner's typed yes and a pinned model id; no model has been called
report_always: verdict table with Wilson 95% per writer model id
origin split: real scenes vs seeded mutants (law 30)
claims whose quote is repeated in the source

routes_may_change: the order of work and what a person sees first; never a witness status
